title: Use native Vulkan rendering on Android
requires: Physical Android Vulkan device and Android build toolchain
scope: Connect the common Vulkan Gallery renderer to Android surfaces and remove ordinary-frame software image copies.
acceptance: Android renders directly from public GPU outputs with explicit physics/graphics ordering and no ordinary-frame CPU readback.
Rotation, resize, background, surface recreation and teardown pass on a physical device without stale or foreign resources.
evidence: PASS: Pixel 7 Android 17 physical Vulkan run at 0f40687; 28 scenes, direct presentation, zero ordinary readback, background, resize, rotation and teardown; docs/roadmap/evidence/F7-16-android-vulkan-gallery.json
PASS: Linux physical Vulkan renderer/surface/session contracts 3/3 and ARM64 Android Vulkan APK build; docs/roadmap/evidence/F7-16-android-vulkan-gallery.json
